produces: Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
prerequisites: All three on the battlefield. Opponents' libraries have nonland cards.
steps:
One or more nonland cards are milled: Mothman puts a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage draws a card.
Psychic Corrosion makes each opponent mill two cards.
Repeat while the milled cards include a nonland card.
notes: Combo B in the deck's CLAUDE.md. Stops when a mill hits only lands; each draw is optional (Fathom Mage says 'may').
